title: Every translated width-2 row sum lies below the displayed Gaussian bound (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, every off-diagonal row sum on the 10-vertex path is strictly below `exp(-2 a theta)+5 exp(-2 a)`. At these parameters that expression is `exp(-9 pi/722)+5 exp(-18 pi)`.
- The forward step from vertex 0 equals the first term. Every other in-band entry has coefficient at least `6462/361`, and `exp(36 pi/361)` is strictly below `5/3`, so three copies of the largest other entry are strictly smaller than `5 exp(-18 pi)`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one translated width-2 section, not the all-size row-gap claim.
